- TPM (Technical/Product/Project/Program Manager)

- Software engineering

- Leadership

- Communication
- Track record of delivery
- Collaborative
- Consumer obsessed

- 4+ years TPM experience

- CVS Health Digital
- Enterprise initiatives
- Engineering teams

- Business stakeholders

**Key Action Words:**
- Drive delivery
- Lead initiatives
- Identify opportunities
- Shape complex initiatives
- Manage stakeholders

These keywords would be essential to include in a resume or cover letter when applying for this position.
